lines.en: label firsttimelibrary:
scene black
I decide to spend the morning at the library.
lines.zh: 我决定在图书馆度过这个上午。

lines.en: It’s still a little too early for me to bother getting involved in whatever is going on in the more exciting parts of town, so I figure relaxing in here is probably the best way to avoid that.
lines.zh: 现在去城里那些热闹地方凑热闹还太早了点，所以我觉得在这儿放松一下，大概是回避那些事的最好办法。

lines.en: Besides, the library is attached to the school, which greatly increases my chances of bumping into one of my students and ultimately having sex with them.
lines.zh: 而且图书馆就挨着学校，这大大增加了我撞见某个学生、并最终和她上床的概率。

lines.en: This calculated move has been brought to you in part by a man with nothing to lose and everything to gain.
lines.zh: 这个精心计算的举动，部分由一位一无所有、只赚不赔的男人为您呈现。

lines.en: : Oh! Good morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 啊！早上好，Sensei。

lines.en: scene blossomredux1
: Good morning, Futaba. What brings you here today?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Futaba。今天怎么来这儿了？

lines.en: : The same thing that always brings me here, I suppose...Until someone else volunteers to handle mornings, I'll be right where I always am on Saturday and Sunday.
lines.zh: : 我想，还是和往常一样的原因吧……在有人自愿接手早上之前，周六周日我都会待在我一向待的地方。

lines.en: Ah. So Futaba volunteers at the school library over the weekend. I guess that seems pretty in-line with the type of girl she came across as in {i}my{/i} journal.
lines.zh: 啊。所以 Futaba 周末在学校图书馆做志愿者。这倒是和她在{i}我的{/i}日记里给人的那种印象挺吻合的。

lines.en: : You’re here early as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 你还是一如既往地来得早呢。

lines.en: And...I suppose {i}I{/i} also frequently drop by on the weekends? I guess that's useful to know.
lines.zh: 而且……看来{i}我{/i}以前也经常在周末过来？知道这个倒挺有用。

lines.en: I wonder if whoever the last person to possess this body was {i}also{/i} wound up being dragged here by an early morning appetite for immorality?
lines.zh: 不知道上一个拥有这副身体的人，是不是{i}也{/i}因为一大早对不道德的渴求而被拖到这儿来的？

lines.en: : You know me. Early bird gets the worm and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 你了解我的。早起的鸟儿有虫吃之类的。

lines.en: I do my best to feign a slightly pompous teacher-laugh but it sounds pretty terrible and I promise myself to never try that again.
lines.zh: 我努力装出一副略显自负的教师式笑声，但听起来实在糟糕，我暗自发誓再也不试第二次了。

lines.en: scene blossomredux2
: Hahaha...right...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: scene blossomredux3
: Oh! That reminds me...Do you have a moment to go over the homework assignment from last week with me?
lines.zh: : 哦！说到这个想起来了……你有空陪我看一下上周布置的作业吗？

lines.en: : I was going to wait until we were in class again but, seeing as you're here right now...there's not really a need to wait.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算等上课再说的，不过既然你现在就在这儿……也就没什么等的必要了。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...sure. You might need to remind me what that assignment actually was, though.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……当然。不过你可能得提醒我那份作业到底是什么。

lines.en: : Of course, Sensei. I don't mind at all. Just give me a moment to get my notebook.
lines.zh: : 没问题，Sensei。我一点都不介意。给我一会儿去拿笔记本。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba retreats behind the front desk and reaches into something on one of the shelves I can't see from where I'm standing.
lines.zh: Futaba 退到前台后面，伸手去够某个我站在这里看不见的架子上的东西。

lines.en: She returns a moment later and pulls up a seat next to me, revealing a bright pink notebook that, based on a few glimpses I'm able to steal of the insides, seems pretty well-used.
lines.zh: 她片刻后回来，在我旁边拉了张椅子坐下，掏出一本亮粉色的笔记本——从我能偷瞄到的几眼内页来看，这本子用得相当旧了。

lines.en: The scent of her perfume tickles my nostrils as a gust of wind from the open window steers it closer to me.
lines.zh: 敞开的窗户吹进一阵风，把她身上的香水味送到我鼻尖，惹得我发痒。

lines.en: It’s a mix of lemon and lavender- or at least something along those lines.
lines.zh: 是柠檬和薰衣草的混合味——至少是那一类的味道。

lines.en: It’s subtle, but enjoyable...The type of scent I wouldn’t mind waking up to every day.
lines.zh: 很淡，但很舒服……是那种我每天醒来都不会介意闻到的气味。

lines.en: scene blossomredux4
: The assignment you gave us was another, umm...poetry interpretation thing.
lines.zh: : 你给我们布置的作业又是那个……嗯……诗歌解读之类的。

lines.en: : The part I'm having trouble with is this one poem in particular.
lines.zh: : 我卡住的是其中这一首诗。

lines.en: : I know that all you asked us to do was give you our interpretation of the writer’s words, but...I guess I'm just having trouble actually {i}interpreting{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 我知道你只要求我们写出自己对作者文字的理解，可是……我好像就是没法真正{i}「解读」{/i}出什么来。

lines.en: : Not much of a poetry person?
lines.zh: : 不太喜欢诗歌？

lines.en: scene blossomredux5
: I like it! It's just...harder than what I'm used to.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢的！只是……比我习惯读的东西要难。

lines.en: : I...umm...well, I read mostly fantasy. And there's usually a lot less {i}interpreting{/i} to do in books that often overload you on details.
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……我主要读奇幻。而这种往往用大量细节把你淹没的书，通常不太需要你去{i}「解读」{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Let's see what we've got here, then.
lines.zh: : 有道理。那我们来看看这里写的是什么吧。

lines.en: I peer into the notebook and scan the pages for whatever poem Futaba is referencing.
lines.zh: 我凑近笔记本，翻找 Futaba 说的那首诗。

lines.en: Thankfully, her handwriting is both elegant and easy to decipher, so I'm able to find it in no time at all...
lines.zh: 幸好她的字既秀气又好认，我很快就找到了……

lines.en: : 'There are days we live...as if death were nowhere...in the background; from joy to joy to joy...
lines.zh: : 「有些日子我们活着……仿佛死亡无处不在……就在那背景里；从喜悦到喜悦再到喜悦……

lines.en: : From wing to wing...from blossom to blossom...to impossible blossom...to sweet impossible blossom.'
lines.zh: : 从翅膀到翅膀……从花朵到花朵……到不可能的花……到甜美的不可能之花。」

lines.en: : So...what does all this mean, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……这些到底是什么意思？

lines.en: menu:
Death creeps up on us
lines.zh: 死亡悄然逼近我们

lines.en: : I think this stanza is about how death is much closer than most of us imagine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这一节讲的是，死亡比我们大多数人想象的要近得多。

lines.en: scene blossomredux6
: Really? But that’s in such stark contrast to the rest of the poem.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可这跟诗的其他部分反差太大了。

lines.en: : That’s exactly why this part hits as hard as it does.
lines.zh: : 正因为如此，这一段才有着如此强烈的冲击力。

lines.en: : Like death itself, this poem embodies the same element of surprise typically associated with it.
lines.zh: : 就像死亡本身一样，这首诗也带有那种通常与死亡相伴的意外感。

lines.en: : The more sudden type of death, of course. Not the drawn-out type we're all subjected to enduring over the course of our lives.
lines.zh: : 当然是那种突如其来的死亡。不是我们一生中被迫慢慢熬过去的那种。

lines.en: : That's...so much darker than I thought. No wonder I couldn't get it.
lines.zh: : 这……比我想的要阴暗多了。难怪我没看懂。

lines.en: : Of course, we’re all free to create our own interpretations of the work. That’s the entire point of poetry, after all.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们每个人都可以对作品有自己的解读。说到底，这正是诗歌的意义所在。

lines.en: : I'm just letting you know how I feel about it.
lines.zh: : 我只是告诉你我的感受罢了。

lines.en: : Wow...
: You’re amazing, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你真厉害，Sensei……

lines.en: : I exist.
lines.zh: : 我存在罢了。

lines.en: : I might not be a great or attentive teacher, but even I can handle this much.
lines.zh: : 我或许算不上什么优秀、细心的老师，但这种程度的事我还是做得来的。

lines.en: jump chosepoem
Happiness is fleeting
lines.zh: 幸福转瞬即逝

lines.en: : The writer is attempting to get across how fleeting happiness can be.
lines.zh: : 作者想表达的是幸福有多么短暂易逝。

lines.en: scene blossomredux7
: That’s actually really close to what I thought at first!
lines.zh: : 这其实和我一开始想的非常接近！

lines.en: : The use of the ‘impossible blossom’ as a metaphor for happiness shows how unattainable and immature a never-ending state of ecstasy can and would be.
lines.zh: : 用「不可能的花」来比喻幸福，正说明了那种永无止境的狂喜是多么遥不可及、又多么幼稚。

lines.en: : See? It's really not that hard if you just go with your gut feeling.
lines.zh: : 看吧？只要凭直觉走，其实一点都不难。

lines.en: : Overanalyzing things not only serves to break immersion and take you out of a moment, but is often entirely wrong and pointlessly convoluted.
lines.zh: : 过度分析不仅会破坏代入感、让你从当下抽离，而且往往是完全错误又无谓地绕弯子。

lines.en: : I guess that's just me being a little pretentious, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，这大概也是我有点自以为是吧。

lines.en: scene blossomredux8
: Heheh! Maybe...
lines.zh: : 呵呵！也许吧……

lines.en: : Thanks so much for your help, though. I'm a lot more confident in my answer now.
lines.zh: : 不过还是非常感谢你。我现在对自己的答案有信心多了。

lines.en: : No problem. I expected nothing less from my star student.
lines.zh: : 不客气。我的得意门生本来就该是这个水平。

lines.en: scene blossomredux9
: Oh stop...We both know that role belongs to Makoto...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了……我们都知道那个位置属于 Makoto……

lines.en: : She's probably writing up a ten page paper on this as we speak.
lines.zh: : 她说不定这会儿正在写十页纸的论文呢。

lines.en: : Yes, well, Makoto is a monster and that amount of work is entirely unnecessary.
lines.zh: : 是没错啦，不过 Makoto 是个怪物，写那么多根本没必要。

lines.en: jump chosepoem
He likes blossoms?
lines.zh: 他喜欢花？

lines.en: : I think the writer just enjoys blossoms.
lines.zh: : 我觉得作者只是单纯喜欢花。

lines.en: scene blossomredux6
: Was it...really that easy? Was I being too analytical?
lines.zh: : 真的……就这么简单吗？是我太钻牛角尖了吗？

lines.en: : I read that stanza at least eight times trying to figure out a meaning, but to think it was as simple as {i}literally{/i} interpreting it-
lines.zh: : 那一节我至少读了八遍，想找出它的含义，没想到答案竟然就是{i}字面{/i}上的意思——

lines.en: : Can we talk about something else?
lines.zh: : 我们能换个话题吗？

lines.en: : After reading this, I'm not in the mood for poetry anymore.
lines.zh: : 读完这些，我已经没心情谈诗了。

lines.en: scene blossomredux10
: Oh. Umm...of course. I'm sorry if this-
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯……当然。如果这让你——

lines.en: : It's fine. Just talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 没事。换个别的话题就行。

lines.en: : Then...umm...
jump chosepoem
label chosepoem:
scene blossomredux11
: Oh, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking a lot about your new approach to teaching, and I have a question.
lines.zh: : 关于你新的教学方式，我想了很多，有个问题想问。

lines.en: : Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 当然。什么？

lines.en: : So, I understand the informal approach...but I don’t really understand why you want us to treat you more like a friend than an authoritative figure.
lines.zh: : 我理解你那种不拘形式的做法……但我不太明白，你为什么希望我们把你看成朋友，而不是一个权威人物。

lines.en: : Isn’t respect important to you?
lines.zh: : 尊重对你来说不重要吗？

lines.en: : Of course. But you can still respect someone you see as your friend, can’t you?
lines.zh: : 当然重要。但你依然可以尊重一个被你当作朋友的人，不是吗？

lines.en: : You can. It just...seems like a very sudden change of heart to me.
lines.zh: : 是可以。只是……对我来说这像是转变得太突然了。

lines.en: : Did something maybe...happen? Is it okay for me to ask that?
lines.zh: : 是不是发生了什么……什么事？我可以问吗？

lines.en: : I don't want to...overstep my role as a student, but-
lines.zh: : 我不想……越过我作为学生的本分，可是——

lines.en: : You're already venturing outside the box again by calling yourself that.
lines.zh: : 你这么称呼自己，就已经又在越界了。

lines.en: : If this relationship is going to work, you're going to need to stay {i}inside{/i} the box and see yourself as a little more than just a student.
lines.zh: : 如果这段关系要维系下去，你就得待在{i}盒子里面{/i}，把自已看得比「学生」要多一点。

lines.en: scene blossomredux12
: Y...You're right. And I'm sorry.
lines.zh: : 你……你说得对。对不起。

lines.en: : This is all just a little embarrassing for me. Being friends, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这些对我来说都有点难为情。我是说，做朋友这件事。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Well, you’re like...so much cooler than all of us. Wouldn’t being our friend make you look bad?
lines.zh: : 因为……你比我们都酷太多了。跟我们做朋友，不会让你掉价吗？

lines.en: : Look bad in front of who? I don’t talk to anyone else besides all of you girls.
lines.zh: : 在谁面前掉价？我除了你们这些女孩，就不跟别人说话了。

lines.en: scene blossomredux13
: So you...don't have a...g...girlfriend or...anything?
lines.zh: : 所以你……没有……女……女朋友之类的？

lines.en: : Nope. Just all of you.
lines.zh: : 没有。只有你们。

lines.en: scene blossomredux14
: I see...I think I get it now.
lines.zh: : 这样啊……我想我明白了。

lines.en: : You’re a really...interesting person, Sensei...And I’m really glad that you’re our teacher.
lines.zh: : 你真是个……很有意思的人，Sensei……而且我真的很庆幸你是我们的老师。

lines.en: : All of the teachers I had before you...never really seemed to care.
lines.zh: : 在你之前的那些老师……看起来从来都不怎么在乎。

lines.en: : But you actually listen to my problems when I come to you for help. And that...
lines.zh: : 但你在我找你求助的时候，是真的会听我说。这……

lines.en: : That means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 这对我意义重大。

lines.en: : I'm just doing my job in the least exhausting way possible. And if you ever need help, you know where to find me.
lines.zh: : 我只是用最省力的方式做我的工作而已。需要帮忙的时候，你知道去哪儿找我。

lines.en: : Of course...
scene blossomredux15
: On that note, though...maybe I'll start visiting your office again sometime soon?
lines.zh: : 说到这个……也许我很快又会去你办公室找你了？

lines.en: : I stopped coming because I didn't really want to bother you, but...just...being around you helps sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我之前不再去，是因为不想打扰你，可是……只是……待在你身边有时候会让我好受些。

lines.en: Futaba's tone changes- like she's admitting something she's been keeping bottled up.
lines.zh: Futaba 的语气变了——像是在坦白某件一直憋在心里的事。

lines.en: The only thing is that the weight of her admission is so light that I can't imagine there was any reason to keep it bottled up in the first place.
lines.zh: 唯一的怪处在于，她这份坦白的重量太轻了，我实在想不出当初有什么理由要憋着不说。

lines.en: I'm sure mine would feel that same way to someone else, though.
lines.zh: 不过我相信，我自己的那些心事在别人看来也是一样的吧。

lines.en: If I could even pinpoint where that weight is coming from, that is.
lines.zh: 前提是我能指出那份重量究竟来自哪里。

lines.en: Right now, it all just feels like recycled air.
lines.zh: 而现在，这一切感觉都只是循环再利用的空气。

lines.en: : Anyway...I should probably get going now.
lines.zh: : 总之……我差不多该走了。

lines.en: : I’ve got a few other things I need to do today.
lines.zh: : 我今天还有几件事要做。

lines.en: I don't.
lines.zh: 其实没有。

lines.en: scene blossomredux16
: Oh, right! I’m...sorry for taking up so much of your time. I realize how valuable it is for someone like you.
lines.zh: : 哦，对！我……很抱歉占了你这么多时间。我明白对像你这样的人来说，时间有多宝贵。

lines.en: : I came here on my own, remember? You didn't take up anything.
lines.zh: : 我自己来的，记得吗？你没占我什么时间。

lines.en: scene blossomredux17
: Well, I'm sorry anyway. But I'm glad you stopped by again.
lines.zh: : 总之我还是很抱歉。但我很高兴你又过来了。

lines.en: : I’ll see you in[school], Sensei. And thank you for helping me with my homework.
lines.zh: : 那我们[school]见，Sensei。谢谢你帮我看作业。

lines.en: : Any time. I'll see you around, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 随时奉陪。回头见，Futaba。

lines.en: scene black
I leave the library and begin to wander the school grounds, hoping that my mind manages to choose a direction to steer me in.
lines.zh: 我离开图书馆，开始在校园里漫无目的地走，指望我的脑子能替我选个方向。

lines.en: It does, but not until I have already lapped the building three times.
lines.zh: 它确实选了，不过是在我绕着楼转了三圈之后。

lines.en: Futaba and I made eye contact the second time I passed the library window.
lines.zh: 第二次经过图书馆窗边时，我和 Futaba 对上了眼。

lines.en: She still smiled at me, even though she shouldn't have.
lines.zh: 她还是对我笑了，尽管她不该笑。

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ firsttimelibrary = True
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}
